_note: Flagged photographs the site currently renders, held pending an OWNER RULING. Nothing here has been deleted — content decisions belong to the owner and this project keeps what it is given. `tests/flagged.spec.ts` fails if a hard-flagged frame appears that is not on this list, so the count can shrink and never grow by accident. Regenerate with `npm run flagged -- --adopt` and read the diff.
_whyItMatters: This rebuild exists because the previous site used stock photographs of places that were not Thalasses. A flagged frame shipping here would be the same failure with better typography.

frames.subject: A sunbather's legs on a boat deck above the wake and open sea
frames.why: Generic lifestyle boating stock; no estate content visible and impossible to attribute to this property.

frames.subject: White-gloved hand opening the door of a black car
frames.why: Generic luxury-transfer stock photography with no property content at all; the same trope the owner's rule excludes.

frames.subject: Stone lighthouse and harbour wall framed through a yellow-walled arch
frames.why: This is a public Venetian harbour lighthouse and quayside in town, not the estate.

frames.subject: Woman with a backpack photographing mountains from a rocky ridge
frames.why: Reads as generic hiking stock photography of the kind the curator rejected alongside the cyclist frames.

frames.subject: Two safari jeeps on a mountain dirt track past grazing sheep under a heavy sky
frames.why: Generic off-road excursion photograph on an inland mountain track with no property feature visible; reads as bought-in activity stock used to illustrate jeep safaris.

frames.subject: Parasailer under a smiley-face canopy behind a speedboat towing an inflatable
frames.why: Open bay off a built-up town seafront with a commercial watersports boat — a public beach operation, not the estate.

frames.subject: Hands pouring massage oil from a glass bottle over a client's back, frangipani flower beside
frames.why: Indistinguishable from commercial spa stock imagery; no property context whatsoever and a tropical flower inconsistent with the estate.

frames.subject: Personal trainer coaching a woman with a barbell in a gym
frames.why: Generic gym/fitness stock photograph with a car park behind the glass; no connection to the estate.

frames.subject: Blue quad bike parked on a dirt track in front of woodland
frames.why: Generic ATV stock photography; the birch-and-scrub woodland is not Cretan coastal landscape and nothing of the estate appears.

frames.subject: Runner crouching to tie a trainer on a sunlit woodland path
frames.why: Classic generic fitness stock photography - anonymous cropped athlete on a wooded path with nothing of the estate visible.

frames.subject: Scuba divers descending over a sandy underwater slope
frames.why: Generic scuba-diving stock imagery used to illustrate an activity; nothing of the estate is visible and it cannot be attributed to this property.

frames.subject: Stacked white pebbles lettered Spirit, Body and Mind held in an open palm over soft bokeh
frames.why: Generic wellness stock image with overlaid lettering; carries no property content whatsoever.

frames.subject: Wine barrel, bottles, filled glasses and grapes staged before a vineyard at sunset
frames.why: Textbook composited stock beverage photography, not the property; the same objection raised against the branded beer product shots.

frames.subject: Row of wine glasses on a rail in front of a trellised vineyard
frames.why: Generic wine-tasting stock in front of a trellised hillside vineyard; a seafront estate is not this landscape.
